name: Rescue OOX-22/FE!

meta.start: Homing Robot OOX-22/FE, Feral Scar Vale

summary: In Feral Scar Vale, OOX-22/FE! waits for your help on the way to the Forgotten Coast dock. Once it arrives, Oglethorpe Obnoticus wants to speak with you in Booty Bay.

sections.title: A Safe Place to Take Off
sections.body: OOX-22/FE needs an open, safe place for its lengthy take-off. The gnome's voice crackles through the robot as he explains that its built-in cloaking needs time before it works again. Oglethorpe Obnoticus also needs time to make it work. He suggests the Forgotten Coast dock, where everything can be brought online. You escort the robot there from where it stands.

sections.title: Afterwards, Booty Bay
sections.body: Once OOX-22/FE reaches the dock safely, Oglethorpe Obnoticus wants you to speak with him in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Where does OOX-22/FE need to go?
aliases: where do i take the chicken
faq.answer: OOX-22/FE needs to reach the dock along the Forgotten Coast. You escort it from Feral Scar Vale, where you found it.
Oglethorpe Obnoticus is a master inventor whose homing robot series includes OOX-22/FE. He speaks through the robot and can be found in Booty Bay.

faq.q: Why does the robot need to reach the dock?
faq.answer: The dock offers an open, safe place for the lengthy take-off, and Oglethorpe says there is enough room to get everything online. The robot's built-in cloaking needs time before it works again.

aliases: who do i talk to after
faq.answer: Once OOX-22/FE reaches the dock safely, speak to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
